name: inventory-service
description: Owns items, stock levels and the append-only stock ledger (P1, P3). Deployed separately because the requirements require stock to live in its own service that only the procurement API calls; it is intranet-only and the web app never reaches it. Stock level is always the sum of ledger entries; it never edits a level directly. Persistence is held in-service until a database resource is available in the organization catalog. It does NOT hold requests, approvals, receipts or user identity; the procurement API passes the acting user's id for ledger entries.
